resources.string: "Choose how SygixOs replaces the Google TV home screen. You can change your mind later in Settings › Home screen."
"Turn on debugging once, and SygixOs sets everything up itself."
"SygixOs can't use debugging on this TV. Set it up with permissions instead."
"Grant a few permissions. Note: on some TVs, the Google TV home screen may take over again after a full restart."
"A TV option SygixOs uses to set itself up. Change two settings, then come back here."
"In About, press OK 7 times on the build row (its name varies by TV), then press Back."
"In Developer options, turn on “USB debugging”, then press Back."
"Detected automatically when you return to SygixOs"
"Debugging is on. Android will now ask “Allow USB debugging?”. SygixOs needs this to set itself up."
"Otherwise, Android will ask again every time you run setup."
"Android didn't allow SygixOs, and nothing was changed. Try again, check “Always allow from this computer”, then select “Allow”."
"Nothing was changed. Turn on “USB debugging” in Developer options, then return to SygixOs."
"SygixOs is setting up your TV. Don't turn it off until setup is done."
"The TV lets SygixOs start when it turns on"
"SygixOs checks that the TV opens it as the home screen"
"Still on. Turned off only if you choose to."
"SygixOs confirmed that your TV now opens it as the home screen."
"The TV opens SygixOs as the home screen"
"SygixOs doesn't need it anymore. Turn it back on to run setup again or to restore the Google TV home screen."
"On this TV, the Google TV home screen is still the system home screen. SygixOs can keep it or replace it completely. You can change your mind later in Settings › Home screen."
"The Google TV home screen stays the system home screen"
"Turn off the Google TV home screen"
"Turn off the Google TV home screen?"

"SygixOs will become the home screen. Depending on the TV, some Google TV home screen features may disappear: quick settings, program guide, press and hold Home, profile switching. You can restore it in Settings › Home screen. Restore it before uninstalling SygixOs."
"The Google TV home screen stays on. SygixOs now handles the Home button and opens when the TV turns on."
"The SygixOs service brings you back to SygixOs"
"Lets SygixOs open when the TV starts up"
"SygixOs asks to open when the TV starts up"
"On some TVs, the Google TV home screen may take over again after a full restart. SygixOs will let you know."
"One step didn't finish. Completed steps stay in place, so you can try again."
"The Home button still opens the Google TV home screen. Make sure debugging is still on, then try again."
"Make sure debugging is still on, then try again. The statuses shown come from the TV."
"The TV may block SygixOs on the next restart. Make sure debugging is on, then try again."
"Couldn't restore the Google TV home screen"
"For each row, press OK to open the Android setting to change. Turn on SygixOs, then come back here. The status updates automatically."
"The TV blocked this service at startup. Turn it off and on again in Accessibility, or use automatic setup."
"Accessibility settings can't be opened on this TV"
"This TV doesn't allow apps to open at startup"
"SygixOs didn't open automatically at this startup"
"Required by Android. Choose SygixOs in the list, then allow it."
"No setting for this on this TV. Only automatic setup can allow it."
"Nothing else was touched. “Restore the Google TV home screen” only affects the home screen. Permissions can be removed in Android settings."
"The SygixOs service only reads the Home button"
"SygixOs is the TV's home screen. Here's the status of each setup method."
"SygixOs isn't the home screen yet. Here's the status of each setup method."
"Google TV home screen off · SygixOs is the home screen"
"Google TV home screen kept · Home button and startup set"
"Home button and opening at startup allowed"
"Turns it back on and makes it the home screen again"
"The Google TV home screen will be turned back on and become the home screen again. Other changes made by SygixOs stay in place: if its service is still on, the Home button will still open SygixOs."
"A step-by-step guide installs Tsuyu. SygixOs sets itself up and repairs itself if the TV undoes its settings."
"Turn on debugging once, and SygixOs sets everything up, but can't repair itself later."
"Pressing Home or turning on the TV opens SygixOs. All remote buttons keep working."
"SygixOs replaces it completely. Depending on the TV, some remote buttons may stop working."
"Tsuyu lets SygixOs reapply its settings if the TV undoes them. Keep debugging on."
"Tsuyu lets SygixOs reapply these settings if the TV undoes them. Keep debugging on."
"If Home stops bringing you back to SygixOs after a restart, open SygixOs once and it will reapply its settings."
"Couldn't turn off the Google TV home screen"
"It's still on, and nothing else changed. Check that SygixOs still has access, then try again."
"Tsuyu is a free app from the creator of SygixOs. It keeps the access SygixOs needs to set itself up and repair itself."
"SygixOs downloads it and verifies that it really comes from its creator."
"In “Install unknown apps”, turn on SygixOs, then press Back."
"Check the TV's internet connection, then try again, or continue without Tsuyu."
"It was deleted without being installed. Try again later, or continue without Tsuyu."
"Android didn't install Tsuyu, and nothing was changed. Try again and select “Install”, or continue without Tsuyu."
"Tsuyu is opening. Follow these steps, then press Back to return to SygixOs."
"This lets Tsuyu start again with the TV."
"Check “Always allow from this computer”, then select “Allow”"
"Tsuyu is active. It will ask whether SygixOs can use it."
"To be safe, Tsuyu highlights “Refuser” (Deny) first. Move to “Autoriser” (Allow)."
"Tsuyu denied access, and nothing was changed. Try again and select “Autoriser” (Allow)."
"Tsuyu remembered your choice and won't ask again. Continue without Tsuyu. SygixOs will use debugging to set itself up."
"Fully replace the Google TV home screen"
"Turns it off. Depending on the TV, some remote buttons may stop working."
"Reapplies settings if the TV undoes them"
"This TV's debugging doesn't let Tsuyu start"
"Installed by SygixOs. It keeps debugging access."
